hero.title: Care@Home
hero.tagline: AI that Cares for Aging at Home
hero.description: Developing a cutting-edge AI-based contactless monitoring ecosystem that supports independent living, reduces healthcare workload, and improves quality of life for older adults.

image.alt: An older woman reading a book in an armchair at home, with a small sensor on the wall

overview.heading: Project Overview
overview.text: Care@Home develops an AI-powered ecosystem combining **IoT sensors**, **TinyML**, and **privacy-preserving data processing** to monitor **daily activities**, **vital signs**, and **environmental factors** in real time. The system enables early intervention, supports caregivers, and enhances independent living.
